about.title: Fifteen years of building and powering the Lao PDR
about.lede: Apex Co., Ltd. is a Lao electrical and construction contractor. We build transmission and distribution networks at 115 kV and 22 kV, supply electrical equipment across all three voltage classes, and deliver the piling, roads, bridges, and buildings that carry them.
about.introP1: The company began in foundation and piling work, and that is still the capability with the deepest track record — driven piles, bored piles, sheet piling, and the substructure works that everything above ground depends on. From there the business grew outward into road and bridge construction, building construction, and real estate development.
about.introP2: The electrical side is now the core of the business. Apex builds 115 kV transmission lines and substations, 22 kV distribution networks, and low-voltage installations inside buildings, and supplies the transformers, switchgear, and cable that go into them. Because the civil capability sits in the same company, a substation project does not need three contractors and two programmes.
about.missionText: Build and energise infrastructure that works on the day it is handed over and still works years later — with the test records to prove it.
about.visionText: Be the Lao contractor clients turn to when a project needs power and heavy civil works delivered together, correctly, and on a programme that was honest from the start.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.description: Nobody's programme is worth an injury. Method statements exist to be followed, not filed.

quality.title: Build it right
quality.description: The layer under the one being tested cannot be re-done later. We get it right the first time.

honesty.title: Honest reporting
honesty.description: We report slippage and failed tests when they happen, not when they become impossible to hide.

selfDelivery.title: Self-delivery
selfDelivery.description: Our own crews and plant on the critical path, so accountability sits in one place.

technical.title: Technical rigour
technical.description: Where a drawing conflicts with the ground, we raise it in writing before building a defect.

longTerm.title: Long-term relationships
longTerm.description: Most of our work comes from clients who have awarded us work before.

about.howLede: Every project follows the same rhythm, whether it is a substation, a bridge, or a warehouse.

survey.title: Survey & scope
survey.description: We walk the site, read the ground investigation or the single-line diagram, and confirm exactly what is in scope.

price.title: Price & programme
price.description: We price the confirmed scope and issue a programme, stating the assumptions where documents are still in draft.

build.title: Build & record
build.description: Our own crews and plant deliver the works, keeping the set, compaction, and test records as we go.

handover.title: Test & hand over
handover.description: We test, commission, and hand over as-built drawings, test records, and equipment documentation.

about.capabilityText: Electrical works, foundation and piling, road and bridge construction, and building and property development all sit inside the same company. On projects that need more than one of them, that is the difference between a single programme and a coordination problem.
